books.title: A Child's Seasonal Treasury
books.meta: Betty Jones · widely regarded as the #1 go-to resource for Waldorf circle time · songs, movement games, fingerplays, crafts and recipes organised by season · morning songs, goodbye songs and mealtime blessings

books.title: Let Us Form a Ring (Acorn Hill Anthology)
books.meta: Nancy Foster · WECAN Books · complete circle times including the orchard circle · also includes Dancing As We Sing (spring and summer circles)

books.title: Dancing As We Sing — Seasonal Circle Plays & Traditional Singing Games
books.meta: Nancy Foster · WECAN Books · spring and summer circle plays · for young children in Waldorf early childhood

books.title: A Lifetime of Joy — Circle Games, Finger Games, Songs & Puppet Plays
books.meta: Bronja Zahlingen · WECAN Books · collected, created, adapted and translated over a lifetime of kindergarten teaching · rare and beloved classic

books.title: Movement Journeys and Circle Adventures, Vol. 1 & 2
books.meta: Nancy Blanning & Laurie Clark · WECAN Books · circle games and movement songs addressing spatial integration and sensory development · seasonal movement journeys for Autumn, Winter, Spring, Summer and Anytime · nursery rhyme movements, bean bag games · described as "a book of genius and a gift to young children"

books.title: Spring — Poems, Songs and Stories · Summer · Autumn · Winter
books.meta: Wynstones Press · 4 volumes · wide variety of seasonal poems, songs and stories from British Waldorf kindergartens · D-pentatonic edition · intro by Jennifer Aulie on music in the mood of the fifth · illustrated by David Newbatt

books.title: Spindrift — Poems, Songs and Stories (year-round)
books.meta: Wynstones Press · year-round material including stories from cultures around the world · sections on morning, evening, birthdays and fairy tales

books.title: Gateways — Morning, Evening, Birthdays, Fairy Tales
books.meta: Jennifer Aulie & Margret Meyerkort · Wynstones Press · poems, songs and stories · essential companion to the seasonal volumes

books.title: Sing a Song of Seasons
books.meta: Mary Thienes Schunemann · with CD · pentatonic seasonal songs for kindergarten and early grades · every song recorded

books.title: Lavender's Blue Dilly Dilly
books.meta: Mary Thienes Schunemann · with CD · nursery rhymes and traditional circle games, lullabies

books.title: The Singing Year
books.meta: Candy Verney · seasonal songs and poems, many original · all recorded on included CD

books.title: Pentatonic Songs for Nursery, Kindergarten and Grades 1 & 2
books.meta: Elisabeth Lebret · Shepherd Songbook series · trusted source of monthly pentatonic songs

books.title: I Love to Be Me — Songs in the Mood of the Fifth
books.meta: Channa A. Seidenberg · Wynstones Press · original pentatonic songs

books.title: Merrily We Sing — Original Songs in the Mood of the Fifth
books.meta: Ilian Willwerth · WECAN Books · composed and original pentatonic songs for young children

books.title: One for the Golden Sun — Pentatonic Songs
books.meta: Peter Oram · Starborn Books, Wales · also: A Change in the Year (pentatonic songs)

books.title: The Mood of the Fifth: A Musical Approach to Early Childhood
books.meta: Edited by Nancy Foster · WECAN / Floris Books · classic articles by Jennifer Aulie, Wilma Ellersiek, Rita Jacobs · contributions from Michael Deason-Barrow, Renate Long-Breipohl, Sally Schweizer and many others · key reference for teachers

books.title: Music for Young Children — Quintenlieder
books.meta: Rita Jacobs · translated by Roland Everett · Hawthorn Press · also published as "Quintenlieder – Music for Young Children in the Mood of the Fifth" (Julius Knierim, Rudolf Steiner College Press)

books.title: The Waldorf Song Book
books.meta: Brien Masters · Floris Books · over 100 songs for Grades 3–8, grouped by festival and season · rounds, four-part songs, recorder notation

books.title: The Education of the Child in the Light of Anthroposophy
books.meta: Rudolf Steiner · short foundational essay · the starting point for Waldorf education

books.title: Rhythms of Learning — Key Lectures on Children and Education
books.meta: Rudolf Steiner, edited by Roberto Trostli · approachable selection of Steiner's key lectures with classroom context · excellent for parents and teachers

books.title: The Foundations of Human Experience (Study of Man)
books.meta: Rudolf Steiner · 14 foundational lectures for Waldorf teachers, Stuttgart 1919

books.title: You Are Your Child's First Teacher
books.meta: Rahima Baldwin Dancy · the #1 recommended introduction for Waldorf parents · child development, parenting ideas, descriptions of Waldorf education · over 1,800 ratings on Goodreads

books.title: Beyond the Rainbow Bridge — Nurturing Our Children from Birth to Seven
books.meta: Barbara J. Patterson & Pamela Bradley · rhythm, simple toys, respectful discipline · gentle Waldorf parenting approach

books.title: Heaven on Earth — A Handbook for Parents of Young Children
books.meta: Sharifa Oppenheimer · how to create a slow, meaningful childhood at home · rhythm, festival celebrations, creative play

books.title: Simplicity Parenting
books.meta: Kim John Payne · not explicitly Waldorf but shares its spirit · reducing overwhelm, restoring rhythm and childhood

books.title: Free to Learn — Introducing Steiner Waldorf Early Childhood Education
books.meta: Lynne Oldfield · guide to principles and methods of Waldorf early childhood education · stories, observations and pictures from kindergartens around the world

books.title: What Is a Waldorf Kindergarten?
books.meta: Joan Almon · describes Waldorf kindergarten methods and the practical ways they are applied · accessible introduction

books.title: Waldorf Education — A Family Guide
books.meta: Pamela J. Fenner · comprehensive guide to the Waldorf curriculum and philosophy for families

books.title: Earthways — Simple Environmental Activities for Young Children
books.meta: Carol Petrash · seasonal nature crafts and activities aligned with Waldorf rhythms

cards.name: Nancy Foster
cards.author: Acorn Hill Waldorf Kindergarten, Silver Spring, MD · WECAN
cards.description: Long-time teacher at Acorn Hill Waldorf Kindergarten and leading figure in WECAN teacher education. Her circle time collections are among the most widely used in English-speaking Waldorf kindergartens worldwide.

cards.name: Laurie Clark
cards.author: Denver Waldorf School · Colorado, USA · WECAN
cards.description: Lead kindergarten teacher at The Denver Waldorf School with 27 years of Waldorf kindergarten experience. Mentors Waldorf teachers across North America and presents internationally. Her books with Nancy Blanning are essential circle time resources in the English-speaking Waldorf world — described as "a book of genius and a gift to young children."

cards.name: Betty Jones
cards.author: Waldorf educator · USA
cards.description: Author of the most beloved all-in-one Waldorf circle resource for families and teachers. Her seasonal treasury is the first book recommended to parents entering the Waldorf world.

cards.name: Mary Thienes Schunemann
cards.author: Waldorf musician & educator · USA
cards.description: Completed a full series of pentatonic songbooks with CDs before her death. Her work brought pentatonic singing into many Waldorf-inspired homes that had no prior musical training.

cards.name: Bronja Zahlingen
cards.author: 1912–2000 · Austrian-born Waldorf kindergarten teacher
cards.description: Dedicated her life to creating and collecting circle games, finger games, songs, puppet plays and verses for Waldorf kindergartens. Her collected work is a rare and lasting gift to early childhood education.

cards.name: Jennifer Aulie
cards.author: Waldorf music educator · Wynstones Press / WECAN
cards.description: Author of the introductory essays on "music in the mood of the fifth" found in the Wynstones seasonal series (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spindrift, Gateways). Key voice in explaining pentatonic music for Waldorf teachers.

cards.name: Ilian Willwerth
cards.author: Waldorf musician · WECAN Books
cards.description: Composed original songs in the mood of the fifth for young children.

cards.name: Elisabeth Lebret
cards.author: Waldorf music teacher
cards.description: Author of the respected Shepherd Songbook series of pentatonic songs for nursery, kindergarten and Grades 1 and 2.

cards.name: Candy Verney
cards.author: Waldorf songwriter · UK
cards.description: Author of The Singing Year, seasonal songs and poems — many original, all recorded on included CD.

cards.name: Margret Meyerkort
cards.author: British Waldorf kindergarten teacher · Switzerland-born
cards.description: Long-time British Waldorf teacher and trainer, co-editor of the Gateways anthology.

cards.name: Elsa Beskow
cards.author: 1874–1953 · Swedish · Floris Books (English)
cards.description: The most beloved picture book author in the Waldorf world. Her nature-filled, warmly illustrated books are used in kindergartens across the English-speaking world.

cards.name: Daniela Drescher
cards.author: b. 1966 · German · Floris Books (English)
cards.description: Her elf and gnome illustrations are widely beloved in Waldorf homes. Many books available in English through Floris Books.

cards.name: Brothers Grimm
cards.author: unabridged original tales · many editions
cards.description: Grimm's fairy tales are the foundation of storytelling in every Waldorf kindergarten. The original, unedited versions are strongly preferred.

cards.name: Floris Books
cards.description: Main English-language publisher of Waldorf books, Elsa Beskow, Sibylle von Olfers, Daniela Drescher and early childhood resources. florisbooks.co.uk

cards.name: Wynstones Press
cards.description: Publisher of the seasonal series (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spindrift, Gateways) and other Waldorf circle time resources. Based in the UK.

cards.name: WECAN Books
cards.description: Waldorf Early Childhood Association of North America. Publishes Bronja Zahlingen, Nancy Foster, and key early childhood resources. waldorfearlychildhood.org

cards.name: Waldorf Publications
cards.description: Research Institute for Waldorf Education. Extensive range of teacher resources, songs and verses. waldorfpublications.org

cards.name: Earthschooling / WaldorfBooks.com
cards.description: Large online selection of Waldorf books, curricula and music resources. earthschooling.info

cards.name: Paper Scissors Stone
cards.description: Waldorf supplies and books including Wynstones seasonal series. waldorfsupplies.com

cards.name: WECAN — Waldorf Early Childhood Assoc. North America
cards.description: Teacher training, recommended reading lists, publications and community. waldorfearlychildhood.org

cards.name: AWME — Association for Waldorf Music Education
cards.description: Recommended songbook list, resources for Waldorf music teachers. waldorfmusic.org
